errors.evidence: Description claims the Y-axis is not marked, while the figure shows numerical annotations at each year.

Description states a decline from 2016 to 2017 for the blue line (Broy), but the values are 2,871 (2016) to 2,170 (2017), indicating a drop, which is correct but said to be notable without any more context.

Description does not correctly interpret the trend for the orange line (Stoynost) after the peak in 2019; it does not clearly articulate the return to values of 1,820 (2020) to 1,689.9 (2021) following the peak.
The description does not mention that the values are in millions or provide context that all values are monetary amounts, potentially misleading on the significance of the figures.
